title: LLM概念界定、探测与追踪
summary: 本文提出一种低成本、可应用于任意LLM的线性探测方法，通过精心构建包含/不包含特定概念的数据集来界定概念，训练线性探针检测LLM各层嵌入中的概念，并展示其在长上下文中的追踪能力。在四个概念和三个LLM上验证，为大规模监控模型思考内容奠定基础。
summary_en: This paper proposes a low-cost, LLM-agnostic linear probing method to detect concepts in embeddings. It carefully delineates concepts via datasets with/without them, trains probes, and tracks concepts across contexts. Validated on four concepts and three LLMs, it enables scalable monitoring of model internals.
